finding: Slovak interest rate tightening rose sharply, reaching a net 43.8% in wave 39
bullets: A net 43.8% of Slovak firms (n=76) reported higher interest rates in wave 39, rising 38.3 pp from a net 5.5% in wave 38 — the largest swing across all three geographies, signalling sharply higher financing costs.

Available loan or credit line size tightened for a net 12.4% of Slovak firms (n=74), up 6.3 pp from wave 38, with loan maturity conditions also tightening at a net 11.6% (n=76) — squeezing liquidity buffers.

Euro area interest rate tightening also intensified, with a net 40.0% of firms (n=1,906) reporting higher rates, up 12.7 pp from wave 38, leaving Slovakia 3.8 pp above the EA — widening the regional cost gap.
